40021353.author: पदार्थः
40021353.content: अपृच्छत asked, तदा then, रामः Rama, दक्षिणाशा southern direction, आश्रमम् hermitage, मुनिम् the sage, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, विनय humility, उपेतः endowed with, इदम् this, आह said, वचः words, अर्थवत् meaningful,

40021353.author: Translation
40021353.content: Then Rama, with folded hands and full of humility, asked the sage (Agastya) in the hermitage of the southern direction, speaking these meaningful words.

40021354.author: पदार्थः
40021354.content: अतुलं incomparable, बलम् strength, एतत् this, वै indeed, वालिनः of Vali, रावणस्य of Ravana, च and, न not, तु but, एताभ्याम् with these two, हनुमता with Hanuman, समम् equal, तु indeed, इति thus, मतिः opinion, मम my.

40021354.author: Translation
40021354.content: This strength of Vali and Ravana is indeed incomparable, but in my opinion, it is not equal to Hanuman's.

40021355.author: पदार्थः
40021355.content: शौर्यम् valor, दाक्ष्यम् skill, बलम् strength, धैर्यम् courage, प्राज्ञता wisdom, नयसाधनम् diplomatic skill, विक्रमः prowess, च and, प्रभावः influence, च and, हनूमति in Hanuman, कृतालयाः have made their abode.

40021355.author: Translation
40021355.content: Valor, skill, strength, courage, wisdom, diplomatic ability, prowess, and influence—all these qualities reside in Hanuman.

40021356.author: पदार्थः
40021356.content: दृष्ट्वा having seen, एव indeed, सागरम् the ocean, वीक्ष्य observing, सीदन्तीम् despairing, कपिवाहिनीम् the army of monkeys, समाश्वास्य having comforted, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, योजनानाम् of yojanas, शतम् a hundred, प्लुतः jumped.

40021356.author: Translation
40021356.content: Having observed the ocean and seeing the monkey army despairing, the mighty-armed Hanuman comforted them and then leaped a hundred yojanas across the sea.

40021357.author: पदार्थः
40021357.content: धर्षयित्वा having harassed, पुरीम् the city, लङ्काम् Lanka, रावणान्तःपुरम् Ravana's inner palace, तदा then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, सम्भाषिता spoken to, च and, अपि also, सीता Sita, हि indeed, आश्वासिता comforted, तथा thus.

40021357.author: Translation
40021357.content: Then, having harassed the city of Lanka and Ravana's inner palace, he indeed saw Sita, conversed with her, and thus comforted her.

40021358.author: पदार्थः
40021358.content: सेनाग्रगाः leaders of the army, मन्त्रिसुताः sons of ministers, किङ्कराः servants, रावणात्मजः Ravana's son, एते these, हनुमता by Hanuman, तत्र there, हि indeed, एकेन by one, वितिपातिताः struck down.

40021358.author: Translation
40021358.content: The leaders of the army, the sons of ministers, the attendants, and Ravana's own son—all these were indeed struck down there by Hanuman alone.

40021359.author: पदार्थः
40021359.content: भूयो again, बन्धात् from bondage, विमुक्तेन by one who was released, भाषयित्वा having spoken, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa), लङ्का Lanka, भस्मीकृता was reduced to ashes, येन by whom, पावकेन by fire, इव like, मेदिनी the earth

40021359.author: Translation
40021359.content: By him, who, having been released from bondage, spoke to Daśānana, Lanka was reduced to ashes, as if the earth itself were consumed by fire.

40021360.author: पदार्थः
40021360.content: न not, कालस्य of Time (Yama), न not, शक्रस्य of Indra, न not, विष्णोः of Vishnu, वित्तपस्य of Kubera, च and, कर्माणि deeds, तानि those, श्रूयन्ते are heard, यानि which, युद्धे in battle, हनूमतः of Hanumān

40021360.author: Translation
40021360.content: Such deeds as those of Hanumān in battle are not heard of, even from Time (Yama), Indra, Vishnu, or Kubera.

40021361.author: पदार्थः
40021361.content: एतस्य of this one (Hanumān), बाहुवीर्येण by the strength of arms, लङ्का Lanka, सीता Sītā, च and, लक्ष्मणः Lakshmaṇa, प्राप्ता obtained, मया by me, जयः victory, च and, एव indeed, राज्यम् kingdom, मित्राणि friends, बान्धवाः relatives

40021361.author: Translation
40021361.content: By the valor of Hanumān, I regained Lanka, Sītā, Lakshmaṇa, victory, my kingdom, friends, and relatives.

40021362.author: पदार्थः
40021362.content: हनूमान् Hanumān, यदि if, मे my, न not, स्यात् would be, वानराधिपतेः of the lord of monkeys (Sugrīva), सखा friend, प्रवृत्तिम् news, अपि even, कः who, वेत्तुम् to know, जानक्याः of Janakī (Sītā), शक्तिमान् capable, भवेत् would be

40021362.author: Translation
40021362.content: If Hanumān, the friend of the lord of monkeys, had not been with me, who would have been capable of even finding news of Janakī?

40021363.author: पदार्थः
40021363.content: किमर्थम् why, वालि Vāli, अनेन by this one (Hanumān), एव indeed, सुग्रीवप्रियकाम्यया by the desire to please Sugrīva, तदा then, वैरे when enmity, समुत्पन्ने had arisen, न not, दग्धः burnt, वीरुधः creepers, यथा like

40021363.author: Translation
40021363.content: Why then, when enmity had arisen, was Vāli not burnt by Hanumān, out of a desire to please Sugrīva, just like creepers are burnt?

40021364.author: पदार्थः
40021364.content: नहि not indeed, वेदितवान् knew, मन्ये I think, हनूमान् Hanuman, आत्मनः his own, बलम् strength, यत् because, दृष्टवान् he saw, जीवितेष्टम् dear as life, क्लिश्यन्तम् suffering, वानराधिपम् the king of monkeys.

40021364.author: Translation
40021364.content: I believe Hanuman did not know his own strength, because he saw Sugriva, who was dear to him as life, suffering.

40021365.author: पदार्थः
40021365.content: एतत् this, मे to me, भगवन् O revered one, सर्वम् all, हनूमति regarding Hanuman, महामतौ the great-minded one, विस्तरेण in detail, यथातत्त्वम् truly, कथय please tell, अमरपूजित O one worshipped by gods.

40021365.author: Translation
40021365.content: O revered one, worshipped by gods, please tell me all about the great-minded Hanuman in detail and truly.

40021366.author: पदार्थः
40021366.content: राघवस्य of Rama, वचः words, श्रुत्वा having heard, हेतुयुक्तम् reasonable, ऋषिः the sage, तदा then, हनूमतः of Hanuman, समक्षम् in the presence, तम् to him, इदम् these, वचनम् words, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40021366.author: Translation
40021366.content: Having heard Rama's reasonable words, the sage then spoke these words to him in Hanuman's presence.

40021367.author: पदार्थः
40021367.content: सत्यम् true, एतत् this, रघुश्रेष्ठ O best of Raghus, यत् what, ब्रवीषि you say, हनूमतः of Hanuman, न not, बले in strength, विद्यते exists, तुल्यः an equal, न not, गतौ in speed, न not, मतौ in intellect, परः another.

40021367.author: Translation
40021367.content: O best of Raghus, what you say about Hanuman is true: there is no one equal to him in strength, speed, or intellect.

40021368.author: पदार्थः
40021368.content: अमोघशापैः by unfailing curses, शप्तः cursed, तु indeed, दत्तः given, अस्य to him, मुनिभिः by sages, पुरा formerly, न not, वेत्ता one who knows, हि indeed, बलम् strength, येन by which, बली strong, सन् being, अरिमर्दनः destroyer of foes.

40021368.author: Translation
40021368.content: Indeed, he was formerly cursed by sages with unfailing curses, by which, though he is strong and a destroyer of foes, he does not know his own strength.

40021369.author: पदार्थः
40021369.content: बाल्ये in childhood, अपि even, एतेन by him, यत् what, कर्म deed, कृतं done, राम O Rama, महाबल O mighty-armed, तत् that, न not, वर्णयितुं to describe, शक्यम् possible, इति thus, बालतया due to childhood, आस्यते it remains.

40021369.author: Translation
40021369.content: O mighty Rama, it is impossible to fully describe the deeds performed by him (Hanuman) even in his childhood, as they are beyond words due to his tender age.

40021370.author: पदार्थः
40021370.content: यदि if, वा or, अस्ति is, तु indeed, अभिप्रायः desire, तत् that, श्रोतुम् to hear, तव your, राघव O Raghava, समाधाय concentrating, मतिम् mind, राम O Rama, निशामय listen, वदामि I speak, अहम् I.

40021370.author: Translation
40021370.content: O Raghava, if you indeed have a desire to hear those deeds, then O Rama, concentrate your mind and listen, for I shall narrate them.

40021371.author: पदार्थः
40021371.content: सूर्यदत्तवरस्वर्णः golden due to a boon given by the Sun, सुमेरुः Sumeru, नाम named, पर्वतः mountain, यत्र where, राज्यम् kingdom, प्रशास्ति rules, अस्य his, केसरी Kesari, नाम named, वै indeed, पिता father.

40021371.author: Translation
40021371.content: There is a mountain named Sumeru, golden due to a boon granted by the Sun, where his (Hanuman's) father, named Kesari, indeed rules.

40021372.author: पदार्थः
40021372.content: तस्य his, भार्या wife, बभूव was, एषा this, हि indeed, अञ्जना Anjana, इति thus, परिश्रुता well-known, जनयामास begot, तस्यां in her, वै indeed, वायुः Vayu, आत्मजम् son, उत्तमम् excellent.

40021372.author: Translation
40021372.content: His (Kesari's) well-known wife was Anjana, in whom Vayu, the Wind-god, indeed begot an excellent son.

40021373.author: पदार्थः
40021373.content: शालिशूकनिभाभासम् having a luster like a ripe paddy grain, प्रासूता gave birth, अमुम् to him, तदा then, अञ्जना Anjana, फलानि fruits, आहर्तुकामा desiring to bring, वै indeed, निष्क्रान्ता went out, गहनेचरा moving in the forest.

40021373.author: Translation
40021373.content: Anjana, who moved in the forest, then gave birth to him (Hanuman), who had a luster like a ripe paddy grain, and she had gone out desiring to gather fruits.

40021374.author: पदार्थः
40021374.content: एषः this (one), मातुः of mother, वियोगात् from separation, च and, क्षुधया by hunger, च and, भृशार्दितः greatly distressed, रुरोद cried, शिशुः the child, अत्यर्थम् exceedingly, शिशुः a child, शरवणे in the reed-forest, यथा just as,

40021374.author: Translation
40021374.content: This child, greatly distressed by separation from his mother and by hunger, cried exceedingly, just like the child Kartikeya in the reed-forest.

40021375.author: पदार्थः
40021375.content: तदा then, उद्यन्तम् rising, विवस्वन्तम् the sun, जपापुष्पोत्करोपमम् resembling a cluster of hibiscus flowers, ददर्श he saw, फललोभात् from desire for fruit, च and, हि indeed, उत्पपात he flew up, रविम् towards the sun, प्रति towards,

40021375.author: Translation
40021375.content: Then, he saw the rising sun, which resembled a cluster of hibiscus flowers, and out of a desire for fruit, he indeed flew up towards the sun.

40021376.author: पदार्थः
40021376.content: बालार्काभिमुखः facing the morning sun, बालः the child, बालार्कः the morning sun, इव like, मूर्तिमान् embodied, ग्रहीतुकामः desirous of seizing, बालार्कम् the morning sun, प्लवते he soars, अम्बरमध्यगः moving through the middle of the sky,

40021376.author: Translation
40021376.content: The child, facing the morning sun, soared through the middle of the sky like an embodied morning sun, desirous of seizing the sun itself.

40021377.author: पदार्थः
40021377.content: एतस्मिन् in this, प्लवमाने soaring, तु indeed, शिशुभावे in the state of a child, हनूमति Hanumān, देवदानवयक्षाणाम् of gods, demons, and yakshas, विस्मयः wonder, सुमहान् very great, अभूत् arose,

40021377.author: Translation
40021377.content: Indeed, a very great wonder arose among the gods, demons, and yakshas as this child Hanumān soared through the sky.

40021378.author: पदार्थः
40021378.content: न not, अपि even, एवम् thus, वेगवान् swift, वायुः wind, गरुडः Garuda, वा or, मनः mind, तथा similarly, यथा as, अयम् this, वायुपुत्रः son of Vayu, तु indeed, क्रमते traverses, अम्बरम् the sky, उत्तमम् excellent,

40021378.author: Translation
40021378.content: Neither the wind, nor Garuda, nor even the mind is as swift as this son of Vayu, who indeed traverses the high sky.

40021379.author: पदार्थः
40021379.content: यदि if, तावत् indeed, शिशोः of this child, अस्य of this, तु indeed, ईदृशः such, गतिविक्रमः speed and prowess, यौवनम् youth, बलम् strength, आसाद्य having attained, कथम् how, वेगः speed, भविष्यति will be

40021379.author: Translation
40021379.content: If this child, even in his infancy, possesses such speed and prowess, how much greater will his velocity become when he attains youth and full strength?

40021380.author: पदार्थः
40021380.content: तम् him, अनुप्लवते follows, वायुः the wind, प्लवन्तम् flying, पुत्रम् son, आत्मनः his own, सूर्यदाहभयात् from the fear of being burnt by the sun, रक्षन् protecting, तुषारचयशीतलः cool with a mass of frost

40021380.author: Translation
40021380.content: Vayu, the wind god, followed his own son (Hanuman) as he flew, protecting him from the sun's scorching heat by making himself cool with a mass of frost.

40021381.author: पदार्थः
40021381.content: बहुयोजनसाहस्रम् many thousands of yojanas, क्रामति traverses, एषः this one, गतः gone, अम्बरम् to the sky, पितुः of his father, बलात् by the strength, च and, बाल्यात् by his childishness, च and, भास्कर the sun, अभ्याशम् proximity, आगतः has come

40021381.author: Translation
40021381.content: This child, having traversed many thousands of yojanas into the sky, reached the vicinity of the sun, driven by his father's strength and his own childish innocence.

40021382.author: पदार्थः
40021382.content: शिशुः a child, एषः this, तु indeed, अदोषज्ञः innocent, इति thus, मत्वा having thought, दिवाकरः the sun, कार्यम् a purpose, च and, अत्र in this (child), समायत्तम् dependent, इति thus, एवम् in this manner, न not, ददाह burnt, सः he

40021382.author: Translation
40021382.content: Considering this child to be innocent and realizing that a significant purpose was dependent on him, the sun did not burn him.

40021383.author: पदार्थः
40021383.content: यम् which, एव indeed, दिवसम् day, हि indeed, एषः this one, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, भास्करम् the sun, प्लुतः leaped, तम् that, एव indeed, दिवसम् day, राहुः Rahu, जिघृक्षति desires to seize, दिवाकरम् the sun

40021383.author: Translation
40021383.content: On the very day that this child leaped to seize the sun, Rahu also desired to grasp the sun.

40021384.author: पदार्थः
40021384.content: अनेन by him, सः he, परामृष्टः touched, राम O Rama, सूर्यरथोपरि upon the sun's chariot, अपक्रान्तः departed, ततः then, त्रस्तः frightened, राहुः Rahu, चन्द्रार्कमर्दनः the tormentor of the moon and sun.

40021384.author: Translation
40021384.content: O Rama, when he (the original Rahu), the tormentor of the moon and sun, was touched by that other one upon the sun's chariot, he became frightened and departed from there.

40021385.author: पदार्थः
40021385.content: सः he, इन्द्रभवनम् to Indra's abode, गत्वा having gone, सरोषः enraged, सिंहिकासुतः the son of Simhika, अब्रवीत् spoke, भ्रुकुटिम् a frown, कृत्वा having made, देवम् to the god, देवगणैर्वृतम् surrounded by hosts of gods.

40021385.author: Translation
40021385.content: The enraged son of Simhika (Rahu), having gone to Indra's abode, spoke to the god (Indra) who was surrounded by hosts of gods, making a frown.

40021386.author: पदार्थः
40021386.content: बुभुक्षापनयम् the removal of hunger, दत्त्वा having given, चन्द्रार्कौ the moon and the sun, मम to me, वासव O Vasava, किम् what, इदम् this, तत् that, त्वया by you, दत्तम् given, अन्यस्य to another, बलवृत्रहन् O slayer of Bala and Vritra.

40021386.author: Translation
40021386.content: O Vasava, O slayer of Bala and Vritra, having given the moon and sun to me as a means to satisfy my hunger, why have you now given them to another?

40021387.author: पदार्थः
40021387.content: अद्य today, अहम् I, पर्वकाले at the time of conjunction, तु indeed, जिघृक्षुः desirous of seizing, सूर्यम् the sun, आगतः arrived, अथ then, अन्यः another, राहुः Rahu, आसाद्य having approached, जग्राह seized, सहसा suddenly, रविम् the sun.

40021387.author: Translation
40021387.content: Today, I had indeed arrived at the time of conjunction intending to seize the sun, but then another Rahu suddenly approached and seized the sun.

40021388.author: पदार्थः
40021388.content: सः he, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् the words, श्रुत्वा having heard, वासवः Vasava, सम्भ्रमान्वितः filled with agitation, उत्पपात sprang up, आसनम् his seat, हित्वा having left, च and, उद्वहन् carrying, काञ्चनीम् golden, स्रजम् garland.

40021388.author: Translation
40021388.content: Having heard Rahu's words, Vasava (Indra), filled with agitation, sprang up, abandoning his seat and still wearing his golden garland.

40021389.author: पदार्थः
40021389.content: ततः then, कैलासकूटाभं resembling the peak of Kailasa, चतुर्दन्तं four-tusked, मदस्रवम् from which ichor flows, शृङ्गारधारिणं adorned with ornaments, प्रांशुं tall, स्वर्णघण्टाट्टहासिनम् loudly laughing with golden bells,

40021389.author: Translation
40021389.content: Then (Indra's elephant) appeared, resembling the peak of Kailasa, four-tusked, with ichor flowing, adorned with ornaments, tall, and making a loud sound with its golden bells.

40021390.author: पदार्थः
40021390.content: इन्द्रः Indra, करीन्द्रम् the lord of elephants, आरुह्य having mounted, राहुम् Rahu, कृत्वा having made, पुरःसरम् a forerunner, प्रायात् went, यत्राभवत्सूर्यः where the sun was, सहानेन along with this one, हनूमता Hanuman,

40021390.author: Translation
40021390.content: Indra, having mounted his lordly elephant Airavata and making Rahu go before him, went to where the sun was, along with Hanuman.

40021391.author: पदार्थः
40021391.content: अथ then, अतिरभसेन with great speed, आगात् went, राहुः Rahu, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, वासवम् Indra, अनेन by this one (Hanuman), च and, स he (Rahu), वै indeed, दृष्टः was seen, प्रधावन् running swiftly, शैलकूटवत् like a mountain peak,

40021391.author: Translation
40021391.content: Then Rahu, leaving Indra, went with great speed, and he was indeed seen by Hanuman running swiftly like a mountain peak.

40021392.author: पदार्थः
40021392.content: ततः then, सूर्यम् the sun, समुत्सृज्य having completely abandoned, राहुम् Rahu, फलम् as a fruit, अवेक्ष्य having seen, च and, उत्पपात sprang up, पुनर्व्योम again into the sky, ग्रहीतुम् to seize, सिंहिकासुतम् the son of Simhika (Rahu),

40021392.author: Translation
40021392.content: Then, having completely left the sun and considering Rahu as a fruit, Hanuman again sprang into the sky to seize the son of Simhika.

40021393.author: पदार्थः
40021393.content: उत्सृज्य having left, अर्कम् the sun, इमम् this, राम O Rama, प्रधावन्तम् running swiftly, प्लवङ्गमम् the monkey (Hanuman), अवेक्ष्य having seen, एवम् thus, परावृत्त्य having turned back, मुखशेषः one who has only a head remaining (Rahu), पराङ्मुखः turned away,

40021393.author: Translation
40021393.content: O Rama, having left the sun, Rahu, who has only a head remaining, turned away, averting his face after seeing this monkey (Hanuman) running swiftly.

40021394.author: पदार्थः
40021394.content: इन्द्रम् Indra, आशंसमानः desiring, तु indeed, त्रातारम् a protector, सिंहिकासुतः Simhika's son (Rahu), इन्द्र O Indra, इन्द्र O Indra, इति thus, संत्रासात् out of great fear, मुहुर्मुहुः again and again, अभाषत cried out.

40021394.author: Translation
40021394.content: Simhika's son, Rahu, desiring Indra as his protector, cried out "O Indra! O Indra!" repeatedly out of great fear.

40021395.author: पदार्थः
40021395.content: राहोः of Rahu, विक्रोशमानस्य who was crying out, प्रागेव already before, आलक्षितम् perceived, स्वरम् the voice, श्रुत्वा having heard, इन्द्रः Indra, उवाच said, मा भैषीः do not fear, अहम् I, एनम् him, निषूदये will destroy.

40021395.author: Translation
40021395.content: Having already perceived the voice of Rahu crying out, Indra said, "Do not fear; I will destroy him."

40021396.author: पदार्थः
40021396.content: ऐरावतम् Airavata, ततः then, दृष्ट्वा having seen, महत् great, तत् that, इदम् this, इति thus, अपि also, फलम् a fruit, मत्वा having thought, हस्तिराजम् the king of elephants, अभिदुद्राव rushed towards, मारुतिः Maruta's son (Hanuman).

40021396.author: Translation
40021396.content: Then, having seen Airavata, Maruta's son (Hanuman) thought, "This is a huge fruit," and rushed towards the king of elephants.

40021397.author: पदार्थः
40021397.content: तथा thus, अस्य his, धावतः while running, रूपम् form, ऐरावतजिघृक्षया with the desire to seize Airavata, मुहूर्तम् for a moment, अभवत् became, घोरम् terrible, इन्द्राग्न्योः of Indra and Agni, इव like, भास्वरम् shining.

40021397.author: Translation
40021397.content: As he ran with the desire to seize Airavata, his form became terrible and shone brilliantly for a moment, like that of Indra and Agni.

40021398.author: पदार्थः
40021398.content: एवम् thus, आधावमानम् who was rushing, तु but, न not, अतिक्रुद्धः excessively angry, शचीपतिः Shachi's husband (Indra), हस्तान्तात् from his hand, अतिमुक्तेन released, कुलिशेन with the thunderbolt, अभ्यताडयत् struck.

40021398.author: Translation
40021398.content: Indra, Shachi's husband, though not excessively angry, struck him as he rushed forward with a thunderbolt released from his hand.

40021399.author: पदार्थः
40021399.content: ततः then, गिरौ on the mountain, पपात fell, एषः he, इन्द्रवज्राभिताडितः struck by Indra's thunderbolt, पतमानस्य while falling, च and, एतस्य his, वामः left, हनुः jaw, अभज्यत was broken.

40021399.author: Translation
40021399.content: Struck by Indra's thunderbolt, the child fell onto the mountain, and as he fell, his left jaw was broken.

40021400.author: पदार्थः
40021400.content: तस्मिन् upon him, तु indeed, पतिते having fallen, बाले the child, वज्रताडनविह्वले distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, चुक्रोध became angry, इन्द्राय at Indra, पवनः the wind god, प्रजानाम् of the creatures, अहिताय for the harm, सः he.

40021400.author: Translation
40021400.content: When the child, distressed by the thunderbolt's strike, fell, the wind god Vayu became angry at Indra, foreseeing harm to all creatures.

40021401.author: पदार्थः
40021401.content: प्रचारम् movement, सः he, तु indeed, सङ्गृह्य having withdrawn, प्रजासु among creatures, अन्तर्गतः having entered inside, प्रभुः the lord, गुहाम् a cave, प्रविष्टः having entered, स्वसुतम् his own son, शिशुम् the child, आदाय having taken, मारुतः the wind god.

40021401.author: Translation
40021401.content: The lord Vayu, having withdrawn his circulation from among all creatures, took his child and entered a cave.

40021402.author: पदार्थः
40021402.content: विण्मूत्राशयम् the receptacles of feces and urine, आवृत्य having obstructed, प्रजानाम् of creatures, परमार्तिकृत् causing great distress, रुरोध he obstructed, सर्वभूतानि all beings, यथा just as, वर्षाणि the rains, वासवः Indra.

40021402.author: Translation
40021402.content: Causing great distress to creatures by obstructing their excretory functions, he stopped all beings, just as Indra stops the rains.

40021403.author: पदार्थः
40021403.content: वायुप्रकोपात् due to the wrath of Vayu, भूतानि creatures, निरुच्छ्वासानि without breath, सर्वतः everywhere, सन्धिभिः by the joints, भिद्यमानैः being broken, च and, काष्ठभूतानि like wood, जज्ञिरे became.

40021403.author: Translation
40021403.content: Due to the wrath of Vayu, creatures everywhere became breathless, and with their joints splitting, they became like lifeless wood.

40021404.author: पदार्थः
40021404.content: निःस्वाध्यायवषट्कारम् without study of Vedas and oblations, निष्क्रियम् without (religious) activities, धर्मवर्जितम् devoid of righteousness, वायुप्रकोपात् due to the wrath of Vayu, त्रैलोक्यम् the three worlds, निरयस्थम् situated in hell, इव as if, अभवत् became.

40021404.author: Translation
40021404.content: Due to the wrath of Vayu, the three worlds became as if situated in hell, devoid of Vedic study, oblations, religious activities, and righteousness.

40021405.author: पदार्थः
40021405.content: ततः then, प्रजाः the creatures, सगन्धर्वाः with Gandharvas, सदेवासुरमानुषाः with Devas, Asuras, and humans, प्रजापतिम् to Prajapati, समाधावन् rushed, दुःखिताः distressed, च and, सुखेच्छया with the desire for happiness.

40021405.author: Translation
40021405.content: Then, all beings including Gandharvas, Devas, Asuras, and humans, distressed and desiring happiness, rushed to Prajapati Brahma.

40021406.author: पदार्थः
40021406.content: ऊचुः said, प्राञ्जलयः with folded hands, देवाः the gods, महोदरनिभोदराः whose bellies were like large bellies (due to distress), त्वया by you, नु indeed, भगवन् O Lord, सृष्टाः created, प्रजानाथ O Lord of creatures, चतुर्विधाः of four kinds.

40021406.author: Translation
40021406.content: With folded hands, the gods, whose bellies appeared distended from suffering, addressed Prajapati, saying, "O Lord of creatures, indeed, the four kinds of beings were created by you."

40021407.author: पदार्थः
40021407.content: त्वया by you, दत्तः given, अयम् this, अस्माकम् to us, आयुषः of life, पवनः Vayu, पतिः lord, सः he, अस्मान् us, प्राणेश्वरः lord of life, भूत्वा having become, कस्मात् why, एषः this one, अद्य today, सत्तम O best among the good.

40021407.author: Translation
40021407.content: "This Vayu, the lord of our life, was given to us by you; why then, O best among the good, has he, having become the lord of our very breath, acted thus today?"

40021408.author: पदार्थः
40021408.content: रुरोध has obstructed, दुःखम् sorrow, जनयन् causing, अन्तःपुरे in the inner chambers, इव like, स्त्रियः women, तस्मात् therefore, त्वाम् you, शरणम् refuge, प्राप्ताः have reached, वायुना by Vayu, उहताः afflicted, वयम् we.

40021408.author: Translation
40021408.content: "He has obstructed us, causing sorrow, just as women are confined in a harem; therefore, we, afflicted by Vayu, have sought refuge in you."

40021409.author: पदार्थः
40021409.content: एतत् this, प्रजानां of the people, श्रुत्वा having heard, तु indeed, प्रजानाथः lord of the people, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, कारणात् due to the reason, इति thus, च and, उक्त्वा having said, असौ he, प्रजाः the people, पुनर् again, अभाषत spoke

40021409.author: Translation
40021409.content: Having heard this from the people, Prajapati, the lord of creation, then spoke to them again, saying "due to the reason."

40021410.author: पदार्थः
40021410.content: यस्मिन् in which, च and, कारणे reason, वायुः Vayu, चुक्रोध became angry, च and, रुरोध obstructed, च and, प्रजाः O people, शृणुध्वं listen, तत् that, सर्वं all, श्रोतव्यं which should be heard, च and, आत्मनः for yourselves, क्षमम् beneficial

40021410.author: Translation
40021410.content: Prajapati then instructed the people to listen to the entire beneficial reason for which Vayu became angry and caused obstruction.

40021411.author: पदार्थः
40021411.content: पुत्रः son, तस्य his, अमरेशेन by the lord of immortals, इन्द्रेण by Indra, अद्य today, निपातितः struck down, राहोः of Rahu, वचनम् word, आस्थाय having relied upon, ततः then, सः he, कुपितः angered, अनिलः Vayu

40021411.author: Translation
40021411.content: Vayu's son was struck down by Indra, the lord of immortals, today, acting upon the advice of Rahu, which is why Vayu became enraged.

40021412.author: पदार्थः
40021412.content: अशरीरः bodiless, शरीरेषु in bodies, वायुः Vayu, चरति moves, पालयन् protecting, शरीरं body, हि indeed, विना without, वायुं Vayu, समतां equality, याति attains, दारुभिः with wood

40021412.author: Translation
40021412.content: The bodiless Vayu moves within and protects all bodies, for indeed, a body without Vayu becomes equal to a mere log of wood.

40021413.author: पदार्थः
40021413.content: वायुः Vayu, प्राणः life-breath, सुखं happiness, वायुः Vayu, वायुः Vayu, सर्वम् all, इदं this, जगत् world, वायुना by Vayu, सम्परित्यक्तं completely abandoned, न not, सुखं happiness, विन्दते finds, जगत् world

40021413.author: Translation
40021413.content: Vayu is the life-breath, Vayu is happiness, and Vayu is this entire world, for the world finds no happiness when completely abandoned by Vayu.

40021414.author: पदार्थः
40021414.content: अद्यैव just today, च and, परित्यक्तं abandoned, वायुना by Vayu, जगदायुषा by the life-giver of the world, अद्यैव just today, ते they, निरुच्छ्वासाः breathless, काष्ठकुड्योपमाः like wooden walls, स्थिताः remained.

40021414.author: Translation
40021414.content: Just today, the life-giver of the world, Vayu, has abandoned them, and just today, they remain breathless, like inanimate wooden walls.

40021415.author: पदार्थः
40021415.content: तत् therefore, यामः let us go, तत्र there, यत्र where, आस्ते resides, मारुतः Vayu, रुक्प्रदः causing pain, हि indeed, नः to us, मा let us not, विनाशं destruction, गमिष्याम reach, अप्रसाद्य without appeasing, आदितेः of Aditi, सुताः sons.

40021415.author: Translation
40021415.content: Therefore, let us go to where Vayu, who is indeed causing us pain, resides, lest we, the sons of Aditi, meet destruction without appeasing him.

40021416.author: पदार्थः
40021416.content: ततः then, प्रजाभिः with the creatures, सहितः accompanied by, प्रजापतिः Prajapati, सदेवगन्धर्वभुजङ्गगुह्यकैः with gods, gandharvas, serpents, and guhyakas, जगाम went, तत्र there, आस्यति sits, यत्र where, मारुतः Vayu, सुतं his son, सुरेन्द्राभिहतं struck by the lord of gods, प्रगृह्य holding, सः he.

40021416.author: Translation
40021416.content: Then, Prajapati, accompanied by all beings, including gods, gandharvas, serpents, and guhyakas, went to where Vayu sat, holding his son who had been struck by the lord of gods.

40021417.author: पदार्थः
40021417.content: ततः then, अर्कवैश्वानरकाञ्चनप्रभं having the radiance of the sun, fire, and gold, सुतं the son, तदा then, उत्सङ्गगतं placed on the lap, सदागतेः of Vayu, चतुर्मुखः the four-faced one, वीक्ष्य seeing, कृपां compassion, अथ then, अकरोत् showed, सदेवगन्धर्वर्षियक्षराक्षसैः with gods, gandharvas, rishis, yakshas, and rakshasas.

40021417.author: Translation
40021417.content: Then, the four-faced Brahma, seeing the son, who shone with the radiance of the sun, fire, and gold, placed on Vayu's lap, then showed compassion along with the gods, gandharvas, rishis, yakshas, and rakshasas. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे पंचत्रिंशः सर्गः ।। 35 ।। Thus ends the thirty-fifth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
